Name: Pokemon Furniture (CP)
Author: dyanosis
Description:
This is an overhaul of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/62553771]oddandevander﻿'s [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18409](DGA) Pokemon Furniture[/url]﻿. It now works in 1.6 and only uses AT to work.

There are several files to choose from. If you want every generation (of which there are 7), you can just download the [b]Main files[/b]. If you want only specific generations (like say 1, 4, and 6), you can download those separately under [b]Optional Files[/b]. Alternatively, you could download the main zip and then delete the generations you don't want. If there are specific Pokemon that you don't want, you can just delete their textures from the [b]Textures[/b] folder.

[b]One big note[/b] - the main file is just a collection of all the individual optional files. So if an update is released for an individual/optional file, you can just download that folder and replace the appropriate generation's folder and be back in business/updated. This makes things much easier to maintain and update later.

[size=4][b]Even Bigger Note: [/b]This is not backward compatible with the DGA version due to how DGA handled the assets and their internal IDs.[/size]

[b]Config[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Enabled [/b]- Whether this mod does anything. Default [b]true[/b].
[*][b]Show In Catalogue [/b]- Whether Pokemon show up in the Furniture Catalogue.[b] Note[/b]: Due to a limitation with how Furniture works, this also affects random shops (like the Travelling Cart). Default [b]true[/b].
[*][b]In Shop[/b] - Whether the Pokemon show up in Robin's Shop. If you are using multiple Generations, I'd recommend turning this off for each Gen that you don't want showing up. Default [b]true[/b].
[*][b]Non-shiny[/b] - Whether the Regular (non-shiny) versions are available in game. Default [b]true[/b].
[*][b]Shiny[/b] - Whether the Shiny (slightly brighter) versions are available in game. Default [b]true[/b].
[*][b]Individual Pokemon (e.g. Abra) [/b]- Whether that specific Pokemon is available in game. Default [b]true[/b].
[/list]
Some notes about the config - you can disable ALL regular or shiny Pokemon, without having to disable each individual Pokemon of that type, by using the [b]Shiny [/b]or [b]Non-shiny[/b] options. I [b][u]DO NOT[/u][/b] recommend trying to uncheck every single Pokemon. I provided those options for those who want strictly Shiny or Regular. However, if you want shiny of some and not of others, knock yourself out :)
This includes all the original and shiny versions of the Pokemon that existed in the DGA version. I do not own, nor do I plan to make more of, the image files used in this mod. If you would like to contribute, you're certainly welcome to and I'll add your name to the credits.

I would, however, be happy to add more Pokemon (either from existing generations or 8/9 which were not included in the original). However, as stated above, I will not do the art, but I will create the files and handle uploading them and keeping things tidy.

If you have questions, please use the [b]Posts [/b]section.

[size=5][img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]
[/size]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]﻿
[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Compatible with...
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later;
[*]Linux, macOS, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer
[/list][*]No known mod conflicts.
[/list]
